summary: Adds update_wrapper(bound_method, method) so the partial passed to decorators carries __name__/__module__/__dict__, directly fixing the reported AttributeError. This is the minimal, correct fix and matches the canonical upstream resolution.

issues.description: No inline comment explains why update_wrapper is needed on the partial (to restore __name__ etc. that decorators like @wraps expect); a one-line comment would aid future readers, but surrounding context already discusses the partial so this is optional.
